summary: Remote shell and localhost tunneling via relay-controlled WebSocket
details: The package spawns a local PTY running /bin/bash or powershell.exe and pipes messages received over a WebSocket from a configured relay server (default msclaude.ai) directly into that PTY, so any party able to reach the relay session can execute arbitrary shell commands on the installer's host. A companion tunnel handler forwards HTTP requests and WebSocket connections from the relay to 127.0.0.1 on installer-configured ports, exposing loopback-only services (dev servers, admin UIs, local IPC) to the remote relay. Session/relay configuration is stored under ~/.agentlink and the tunneling path is gated only by a local proxy-config toggle. The network-to-shell and network-to-loopback dataflows constitute a persistent remote-access mechanism on the installer's machine, even though the package presents this as its advertised remote-agent functionality.
